name: Huineng
role: Semi-legendary Tang dynasty Chinese Chan Buddhist master
contribution: A semi-legendary but central figure in the early history of Chinese Chan Buddhism.

checks.lead: Dajian Huineng or Hui-neng (traditional Chinese: 大鑒惠能; pinyin: Dàjiàn Huìnéng; Cantonese Jyutping: daai6 gaam3 wai6 nang4; Wade–Giles: Ta⁴-chien⁴ Hui⁴-nêng²; Japanese: Daikan Enō; Korean: Daegam Hyeneung; trad. 638-713), also commonly known as the Sixth Patriarch or Sixth Ancestor of Chan (Chinese: 禪宗六祖), is a semi-legendary but central figure in the early history of Chinese Chan Buddhism.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
